author: val
body: RFC 8446 section 5.1: a record is a 5-byte header, type, version(2) and length(2), then the fragment. A plaintext fragment is at most 2^14 bytes, and a protected record's length is at most 2^14 + 256.

author: val
body: Receives one connection may spend before it is dropped. A handshake and a request take 2 to 4 receives; the bound keeps a silent client from holding the single-threaded listener.

author: val
body: A connection allocates about 19 MB (the handshake's X25519, Ed25519 and key schedule), measured 2026-09-23. Everything it allocates is reclaimed when it closes; only the request count and the verdict, both Integers, cross the restore. Safe because `host-socket` send is the host kernel copying the bytes before it returns, so nothing below the mark is still referenced. The contract this places on the route: it must not keep anything it allocates across requests.
